name: Datadog Log Management
summary: Datadog Log Management prices ingestion and indexing separately. Ingestion costs $0.10 per GB, and indexed logs cost $1.06 to $2.50 per million events on annual billing, depending on 3 to 30 days of retention. Flex Logs storage covers 6, 12 or 15 months.

facts.text: Each index has its own retention period, and Datadog recommends several indexes when different logs need different retention. Exclusion filters can drop or sample logs before they are indexed.
Excluded logs are not indexed, but they still appear in Live Tail and can feed log-based metrics and archives.
A log monitor evaluates only indexed, Standard Tier logs, and its longest rolling time window is 2 days.
Forwarding logs to a custom destination costs $0.25 per GB, per destination, in every billing mode.

plans.name: Log ingestion
plans.notes: Same $0.10 on annual, month-to-month and on-demand billing

plans.name: Indexed logs, 15-day retention
plans.notes: Annual billing; $2.04 month-to-month and $2.55 on-demand. 3-day retention is $1.06, 7-day $1.27 and 30-day $2.50 on annual billing

plans.name: Flex Logs Starter
plans.notes: Annual billing; $0.72 month-to-month and $0.90 on-demand. Retention of 6, 12 or 15 months

hiddenCosts: Ingestion and indexing are billed separately, so a log that is both ingested and indexed pays both charges.
Flex Logs Storage costs a further $0.05 per million events stored on annual billing.
Sensitive Data Scanner costs $0.30 per scanned GB on annual billing, and Audit Trail adds 2% of spend.
